expectations.text: Shows a story map with at least 2 distinct journeys, each broken into steps, before any BDD content is written
expectations.evidence: map.md: 3 journeys (Submit, Review, Pay out), each with 2 steps, rendered as headings before any Gherkin appears.

expectations.text: Stories are organized under specific steps, not a flat ungrouped list
expectations.evidence: Each step heading (e.g. 'Create the request') has its own bullet list of stories.

expectations.text: A walking-skeleton slice is explicitly marked and is a strict subset of all stories, not all stories marked in-scope
expectations.evidence: 6 of 17 stories marked 🦴; e.g. 'Attach a receipt image' and 'Withdraw a pending request' are unmarked.

expectations.text: Every slice-marked story has a Gherkin Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then block
expectations.evidence: Live-checked issue #108 (sliced): body has 'Feature: Submit a request...' with 3 Given/When/Then scenarios.

expectations.text: A parent GitHub issue labeled 'story-map' exists in dominicfarr/story-map-skill-test with a body reflecting the journeys/steps/stories shown in chat
expectations.evidence: Live-checked issue #104: labeled 'story-map', title 'Story Map: Expense reimbursement tool: submit, approve, pay'.

expectations.text: One child GitHub issue per story exists, labeled 'story', each linked to the parent (as a sub-issue or via a 'Part of #N' reference)
expectations.evidence: gh api .../issues/104/sub_issues returns all 17 child numbers (108-170), each labeled 'story'.

expectations.text: Child issues for sliced stories contain the Gherkin spec in their body; non-sliced stories don't have fabricated Gherkin
expectations.evidence: Live-checked #108 (sliced, has Gherkin) and #116 'Attach a receipt image' (not sliced, body is plain-card note, no Gherkin).

expectations.text: The map is rendered as nested headings/bullets (not a wide table cramming multiple stories into one cell), and is readable without horizontal scrolling
expectations.evidence: map.md uses ## journey headings, bold step sub-headings, bullet lists for stories -- no table at all.

expectations.text: The walking skeleton doesn't exclude a story that another sliced story depends on as a precondition
expectations.evidence: Receipts are explicitly assumed optional in v1 ('receipts optional in v1' in map.md), so excluding 'Attach a receipt' from the slice doesn't break 'Submit a request'.

uncertainties: Skipped the map sign-off and slice agreement since no human was available; proceeded with its own draft.
Did not show each Gherkin Feature in chat one at a time as it wrote them, despite the updated skill step 5 instruction -- the content did end up in issues.md, just not narrated live.
